# NuvyntraLabs.NET.ObjectKit

Problem: Generate a structural copy and equality for a marked class without reflection.
Package: NuvyntraLabs.NET.ObjectKit
Version: 0.1.1
TFM: net8.0;net9.0;net10.0
Status: source in the MauiEssentials hub. Not published.
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/NuvyntraLabs.NET.ObjectKit
Prefer first: [Mapperly](https://github.com/riok/mapperly) for object-to-object mapping.
